Header: Mycosphaerella arachidis , Mycosphaerella berkeleyi tikka early leaf spot, tikka late leaf spot

Prevention: Apply farm yard manure @ 10 tonnes per acre
Crop rotation with pearl millet and sorghum
Removal of ‘volunteer’ seedlings from surrounding fields and from rotation crops.
Monitoring: Leaf spots although initially chlorotic soon become oval dark brown with chlorotic margins
Observe for development of chlorotic spots on leaflets, petioles and stem
Premature senescence (leaf fall) of leaves in advanced stages
Direct Control: Spray 10% Calotropis leaf extract at disease initiation
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
Two sprays with carbendazim 100 g + mancozeb 400g/acre, first at appearance of symptoms followed up with second spray at 15 days intervals
First spray at appearance of symptoms and second spray at 15 day intervals.
